INSERT INTO subscription (user_id, type, target, label, main_subject_only, new_names_only, include_abstract_only, include_references, filters, feed_token, since_year, paused) VALUES (#{o.userId}, #{o.type}, #{o.target}, #{o.label}, #{o.mainSubjectOnly}, #{o.newNamesOnly}, #{o.includeAbstractOnly}, #{o.includeReferences}, COALESCE(#{o.filters, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, '{}'::jsonb), #{o.feedToken}, #{o.sinceYear}, #{o.paused}) RETURNING id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM subscription WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE subscription SET feed_token = #{token} WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT FROM subscription WHERE NOT paused AND ( false OR (type = 'SOURCE' AND target = #{sourceId})
OR (type = 'TAXON' AND target = ANY(#{taxonIds, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}))
OR (type = 'NAME' AND target = ANY(#{nameIds, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}))
OR (type = 'TAXGROUP' AND target = ANY(#{taxgroups, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}))
) ORDER BY id
mapper.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (a.created, a.id) < (b.created, b.id) THEN a.id ELSE b.id END AS keep_id, CASE WHEN (a.created, a.id) < (b.created, b.id) THEN b.id ELSE a.id END AS drop_id FROM subscription a JOIN subscription b ON b.type = a.type AND b.target = a.target WHERE a.user_id = #{fromUserId} AND b.user_id = #{toUserId}
mapper.update: WITH pairs AS () UPDATE hit h SET subscription_id = p.keep_id FROM pairs p WHERE h.subscription_id = p.drop_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hit o WHERE o.subscription_id = p.keep_id AND o.work_id = h.work_id AND o.kind = h.kind)
mapper.delete: WITH pairs AS () DELETE FROM subscription s USING pairs p WHERE s.id = p.drop_id
mapper.update: UPDATE subscription SET user_id = #{toUserId} WHERE user_id = #{fromUserId}
